topics.title: Counting
topics.rule: Multiply independent choices for each position.

questions.problem: Use the letters A, B, C, and D. Repetition is allowed.
questions.hint: There are four choices in each of the three positions.

questions.prompt: Count the ways to select two people.
questions.problem: Choose two from a group of five. The order does not matter.
questions.hint: Count ordered pairs first, then divide by the number of orders for each pair.
questions.solution: There are 5 × 4 ordered pairs. Each unordered pair appears twice, giving 10.
